description_expanded: The Enclave on 30A - Vacation Home in Dune Allen Beach by Five Star Properties Favorite Features: - Gigantic Resort-Style Pool (Heat Available) - Less Than 20 Yards from Public Beach Access - Outdoor Kitchen - Pool Table - Elevator - Bunk Rooms  - Golf Cart - Huge Rooftop Deck More About The Enclave on 30A: Located directly on County Hwy 30A, less than 20 yards away from the Dune Allen Beach public beach access, you'll find one of the largest and most luxurious homes on the Emerald Coast. The Enclave on 30A features state-of-the-art amenities, breathtaking views, and masterful design.  This three-story vacation home has everything you need for your next beach getaway. In fact, it even has the best private pool you'll find on all of 30A. Its massive resort-style pool features sunk-in bench seating, a gigantic spa tub, and a swim-up cabana complete with a canopy bed overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. Best of all, the beach is directly across the street, so guests also have easy access to the gulf. The first floor hosts a game room, a half bath, and two guest bedrooms. The game room is complete with a pool table and a wet bar featuring a wine cooler and quartz countertops. Both bedrooms are beautifully decorated and designed. The first guest bedroom features a king bed and ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The second has a queen bed and an ensuite bathroom with two sinks and a walk-in shower. Upstairs on the second floor, you'll find the main living area complete with gorgeous designer furniture, a formal dining area, and a gigantic gourmet kitchen. The living room has beautiful indoor/outdoor furniture and a half bath. In addition, The Enclave has two large formal dining tables each seating up to eight guests overlooking the Gulf of Mexico. The kitchen is right off of the dining area and includes a massive kitchen island, Frigidaire appliances, and leathered quartz countertops. The second floor also has two spacious balconies and two more guest bedrooms. The third bedroom features a twin/twin bunk bed as well as a king bed and twin sleeper sofa. In addition, the third bedroom has an ensuite bathroom. The fourth bedroom features a king bed and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. Finally, the third floor features a den area and the rest of the bedrooms. The den features balcony access as well as a queen sleeper sofa. The fifth bedroom features a king bed, balcony access, and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower and stand-alone bathtub. Next, the sixth bedroom includes a king bed as well as balcony access and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The seventh bedroom also has a king bed and an ensuite bathroom with a walk-in shower. The eighth bedroom features a king bed and a queen sleeper sofa as well as an ensuite bathroom with a stand-alone bathtub in addition to a walk-in shower. Last, but not least, the final ninth bedroom has two sets of twin/twin bunk beds. In addition to all the other incredible amenities within the home, The Enclave on 30A also has one of the largest rooftop decks in the area with a dazzling view of the Gulf of Mexico. The views from the rooftop deck are absolutely incredible and you'll have to see it for yourself to believe it! With a gigantic resort-style pool, plenty of space for entertaining, gorgeous decor, and unparalleled views, The Enclave on 30A is by far one of the most luxurious homes on the Emerald Coast. Sleeping Arrangements: FIRST FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 3: King Bed, Twin over Twin Bunk & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 4: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Shared Balcony & Gulf View. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 5: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub.  Bedroom 6: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 7: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 8: King Bed with Shared Balcony & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 9: 2 Twin over Twin Bunk Beds.
